description: Text-retrieval recall@k on TEXT questions (driver/why -> MD&A, risk -> Risk Factors). For each question, is a chunk from the expected SEC section in the top-k retrieved chunks? Section match normalizes section_label to alphanumerics (SEC labels carry OCR noise). Metric questions are excluded on purpose: they are answered from structured XBRL facts, not by retrieving the financial-statement text, so they are covered by structured-metric accuracy instead. 2 questions x 6 companies.

cases.question: Why did Apple's revenue change year over year?
What are Apple's main risk factors?

What are Microsoft's main risk factors?
